claim_text: Choline requirements increase during pregnancy, but whether a person needs additional supplementation depends on total intake from food and prenatal products; pregnancy alone does not establish a deficiency.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported or duplicate supplementation and support context-specific assessment.

population.other_context: Pregnant people reviewing dietary choline adequacy.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify product label and composition.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Choline Health Professional Fact Sheet provides pregnancy-specific adequate intake values and dietary source information.
limitations: Adequate intake is not proof that a standalone supplement is required; no dose from this claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
